description: This file is a shell script used for automating end-to-end smoke testing of a software deployment on a macOS virtual machine within Parallels. It manages snapshots, installs software packages, verifies versions, interacts with a Discord bot for notifications, and runs various health checks on deployed components such as gateway, dashboard, and agent. The script also generates a JSON summary report of the test results.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints a message prefixed with '==>' to indicate status updates.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints a warning message to STDERR.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to STDERR and exits the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions such as killing server processes and removing temporary directories.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script's command-line options.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Resolves the most appropriate VM snapshot based on the fuzzy hint provided.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Determines the host IP address either from user input or auto-detection.

methods.name: is_host_port_free
methods.description: Checks if the specified host port is available.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Finds and allocates a free port on the host machine.

methods.name: resolve_host_port
methods.description: Resolves and ensures the host port to use, either from user input or by allocating a free one.

methods.name: wait_for_vm_status
methods.description: Waits until the VM reaches the specified status within the timeout.

methods.name: wait_for_current_user
methods.description: Waits until the VM user is logged in and ready.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Executes a command with a timeout on the host.

methods.name: snapshot_switch_with_retry
methods.description: Attempts to switch VM snapshots, with retries on failure.

methods.name: guest_current_user_exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the VM as the current user.

methods.name: guest_current_user_cli
methods.description: Runs a command inside the VM as the current user, with proper environment setup.

methods.name: guest_script
methods.description: Runs a custom script inside the VM using the expect-based method.

methods.name: guest_current_user_sh
methods.description: Runs a shell script inside the VM as the current user.

methods.name: restore_snapshot
methods.description: Restores a VM snapshot and optionally starts it if poweroff.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Fetches the latest version number of openclaw from npm registry.

methods.name: install_latest_release
methods.description: Downloads and installs the latest openclaw release from a specified URL.

methods.name: verify_version_contains
methods.description: Verifies that the installed openclaw version contains a specific substring.

methods.name: extract_package_version_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts the version number from a packed tgz file.

methods.name: extract_package_build_commit_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts the build commit hash from a tgz package.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Creates a tgz package of the current main build or target package.

methods.name: verify_target_version
methods.description: Checks that the current package matches the expected target version or commit hash.

methods.name: current_build_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the current build commit hash from build info JSON.

methods.name: current_control_ui_ready
methods.description: Checks if the control UI has been built and is ready.

methods.name: acquire_build_lock

methods.name: release_build_lock
methods.description: Releases the build lock.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Ensures that the current code is built and the UI is ready.

methods.name: stage_pack_runtime_deps
methods.description: Prepares runtime dependencies for the main package.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a simple HTTP server to serve the tgz package.

methods.name: install_main_tgz
methods.description: Installs the main tgz package inside the VM by downloading from the hosted server.

methods.name: verify_bundle_permissions
methods.description: Checks that npm global install directories are not world-writable.

methods.name: run_ref_onboard
methods.description: Runs the onboard process in reference mode for setting up the system.

methods.name: verify_gateway
methods.description: Verifies the status of the OpenClaw gateway within the VM.

methods.name: show_gateway_status_compat
methods.description: Shows the status of the gateway, handling different command versions.

methods.name: verify_turn
methods.description: Performs a simple turn command to verify the agent's responsiveness.

methods.name: resolve_dashboard_url
methods.description: Obtains the URL of the dashboard for verification.

methods.name: verify_dashboard_load
methods.description: Checks whether the dashboard has loaded properly in the browser.

methods.name: configure_discord_smoke

methods.name: discord_message_id_from_send_log

methods.name: extract_last_version

methods.name: show_log_excerpt

methods.name: show_restore_timeout_diagnostics

methods.name: phase_run

methods.name: write_summary_json

methods.name: run_upgrade_lane
methods.description: Complete lane for upgrading from a snapshot, including verifications and Discord tests.
